name: How do I know if the baseboard installation was done well?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if the baseboard installation was done well?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you want a clean finish, installed baseboards should sit tight to the wall, have neat corners, and show minimal gaps after caulking. Good results also include secure fastening, smooth joints, and a final look that matches the rest of the room.
acceptedAnswer.description: A good job has tight corners, minimal gaps, smooth caulk lines, and a trim line that looks even around the room.
